name: Araku Selection
description: Medium-dark roast. Honey, sugarcane, dark chocolate, caramel. The everyday go-to.

name: Araku Signature
description: Medium roast. Green pepper, cherry, dark chocolate — full of character with a long clean finish.

name: Araku Grand Reserve
description: Medium roast. Floral, dates, citrus, tropical fruits. Silky and full-bodied.

name: Araku Micro Climate
description: Medium roast. Olives, honey, grapes, dried berry. Intensely fruity with a generous body.

name: Honey Sun Dried
description: Arabica from Chikmagalur. Cherry and orange rind. Pulped and sun-dried with thick mucilage — works great for espresso, Aeropress, or iced.

name: Pineapple Fermentation
description: SLN 795 from Chikmagalur, fermented with fresh pineapple. Caramel, toasted nuts, fruit-forward filter roast.

name: House Blend Medium Roast
description: Coorg blend, medium roast. Nutty, dark chocolate, lemongrass. Washed and sun-dried arabicas, smooth finish.

name: Monsooned Malabar
description: Indian Malabar coast. Woody spices, dark chocolate, nutty. Low acidity, earthy, bold.

name: Mudremane Estate Washed
description: Washed arabica. Black tea, floral, sugarcane sweetness with molasses hints. Complex and aromatic.

name: Nitrogen Naturals
description: Ratnagiri Estate. Anaerobic fermentation with lab-cultured yeast, 44 hours, then 26-day natural dry. Mixed berries, molasses, peach.

name: Say Hello to Mellow
description: Light roast single estate, fully washed. Banana, berry, bright and clean. Great as black coffee.

name: Apple of My Brew
description: Chikmagalur anaerobic, shade-dried on raised tables. Apple compote, lemon verbena, sweet spice.

name: Riverdale Estate White Rose
description: Yercaud, Tamil Nadu, 1450m. Light roast, natural process with rose petal fermentation. Blood orange, passion fruit, pomegranate.

name: Kalledevarapura Pulp Sun Dried
description: Chikmagalur, 1280–1340m, S795. Medium roast, pulp sun-dried. Brown sugar, roasted almond, raisin, sweet mouthfeel.
